About ISTD & Jaipur Chapter

The Indian Society for Training & Development (ISTD), established in April 1970, is a national-level professional & non-profit society registered under the Societies Registration Act, 1860. It has a large membership of individuals and institutions involved in HRD, training, education, and organizational development.

The ISTD Jaipur Chapter serves as the vibrant hub for Rajasthan, dedicated to fostering dialogue, upgrading trainer competencies, organizing regional conclaves, and partnering with prominent educational institutions, public sector enterprises, and corporate leaders.

Official Peer-Reviewed Journal

Indian Journal for Training & Development (IJTD)

Indian Journal for Training and Development (IJTD) is the prestigious official publication of the Indian Society for Training & Development (ISTD), New Delhi. Published continuously since 1971, IJTD carries cutting-edge research, critical reviews, case studies, and conceptual papers on human resource development, pedagogy, and organizational psychology.

Peer-Reviewed & Indexed Research Publication
Quarterly Circulation to Academicians, Corporates & Libraries
